name: Healthcare and life sciences
description: Industry and marketing vocabulary only. Contains no clinical guidance and must not be used for medical content without qualified review.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HIPAA
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US law governing the privacy and security of protected health information.

ctx.expansion: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Protected health information. Individually identifiable health data covered by HIPAA.

hasDefinedTerm.name: BAA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Business associate agreement. The contract required before a vendor may handle PHI.

hasDefinedTerm.name: de-identification
hasDefinedTerm.description: Removing identifiers from health data so it falls outside PHI rules.

hasDefinedTerm.name: consent
hasDefinedTerm.description: A patient's documented permission for a specified use of their data or care.

hasDefinedTerm.name: YMYL
hasDefinedTerm.description: Your Money or Your Life. Topics where inaccuracy could cause real harm, held to a higher content quality bar.

hasDefinedTerm.name: medical review
hasDefinedTerm.description: Having a qualified clinician verify health content before publication. Expected practice for health pages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FDA clearance
hasDefinedTerm.description: A regulatory pathway permitting a device to be marketed in the US. Distinct from approval.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FDA approval
hasDefinedTerm.description: A regulatory determination that a product's benefits outweigh its risks for a stated use.

hasDefinedTerm.name: off-label
hasDefinedTerm.description: Use of an approved product for an indication it was not approved for. Promoting it is restricted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EHR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The digital record of a patient's care held by a provider organization.

hasDefinedTerm.name: interoperability
hasDefinedTerm.description: The ability of health systems to exchange data and use what they receive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FHIR
hasDefinedTerm.description: A standard for exchanging healthcare data over web APIs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HL7
hasDefinedTerm.description: A family of standards for exchanging clinical and administrative data between systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ICD-10
hasDefinedTerm.description: The international classification system used to code diagnoses.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CPT code
hasDefinedTerm.description: A standardized code identifying a medical procedure for billing purposes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: NPI
hasDefinedTerm.description: National provider identifier. The unique number assigned to a US healthcare provider.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HIE
hasDefinedTerm.description: Health information exchange. Infrastructure for sharing records across organizations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: patient portal
hasDefinedTerm.description: The interface where patients view records, results, and messages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: payer
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization that pays for care, typically an insurer or government program.

hasDefinedTerm.name: provider
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization or clinician delivering care.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CMS
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US agency administering Medicare and Medicaid.

ctx.expansion: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

hasDefinedTerm.name: Medicare
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US federal health program primarily covering people 65 and over.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Medicaid
hasDefinedTerm.description: The joint US federal and state program covering people with limited income.

hasDefinedTerm.name: prior authorization
hasDefinedTerm.description: Approval a payer requires before it will cover a service or medication.

hasDefinedTerm.name: claim denial
hasDefinedTerm.description: A payer's refusal to reimburse a submitted claim.

hasDefinedTerm.name: revenue cycle
hasDefinedTerm.description: The administrative process from patient registration through final payment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: in-network
hasDefinedTerm.description: A provider with a negotiated contract with a given payer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: value-based care
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reimbursement tied to patient outcomes rather than volume of services delivered.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fee-for-service
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reimbursement per service delivered. The model value-based care is intended to replace.

hasDefinedTerm.name: capitation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Paying a provider a fixed amount per patient per period regardless of services used.

hasDefinedTerm.name: population health
hasDefinedTerm.description: Managing outcomes across a defined group rather than one patient at a time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: care gap
hasDefinedTerm.description: A difference between recommended care and the care a patient has actually received.

hasDefinedTerm.name: care coordination
hasDefinedTerm.description: Organizing a patient's care across multiple providers and settings.

hasDefinedTerm.name: telehealth
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delivering care remotely by video, phone, or asynchronous messaging.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SDOH
hasDefinedTerm.description: Social determinants of health. Non-clinical conditions such as housing or food access that affect outcomes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: readmission
hasDefinedTerm.description: A patient returning to hospital shortly after discharge. A tracked quality measure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: clinical trial
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured study evaluating an intervention in human participants.

hasDefinedTerm.name: IRB
hasDefinedTerm.description: Institutional review board. The body reviewing research protocols for participant protection.

hasDefinedTerm.name: peer review
hasDefinedTerm.description: Evaluation of research by independent experts before publication.

hasDefinedTerm.name: systematic review
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured synthesis of all studies meeting stated criteria on a question.

hasDefinedTerm.name: evidence hierarchy
hasDefinedTerm.description: The ranking of study designs by strength of evidence.

hasDefinedTerm.name: patient acquisition
hasDefinedTerm.description: The marketing function bringing new patients to a practice or health system.

hasDefinedTerm.name: service line
hasDefinedTerm.description: A grouping of related clinical services managed as a unit, such as cardiology.

hasDefinedTerm.name: provider directory
hasDefinedTerm.description: The listing of clinicians and their details. A common source of inaccurate local data.

hasDefinedTerm.name: health literacy
hasDefinedTerm.description: How well a person can find, understand, and use health information.

hasDefinedTerm.name: plain language
hasDefinedTerm.description: Writing calibrated so the intended reader understands it on first reading. A regulatory expectation in patient materials.
